source_title: WISEcode Opens Beta of WISEcode Intelligence™, Its First AI Product for Food and Beverage Companies - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Select brands get the first look at their portfolios and their markets through information that exists nowhere else
NEW YORK , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- WISEcodeâ¢, the pioneer of FoodTechAIâ¢, today opened the beta of WISEcode Intelligenceâ¢, its first AI product built for food and beverage companies. Brands in the beta can see their own products, and their competitors', the way WISEcode scores food: ingredient by ingredient, across the attributes behind health, quality and value.
Food companies know their sales to the decimal. What they haven't had is a clear view of what's in the products on the shelf, down to what each ingredient on the label actually is. Labels list ingredients without explaining them, and sales reports do not explain ingredients. WISEcode Intelligence fills that gap with The Food Genome Projectâ¢, WISEcode's ingredient-level map of the U.S. packaged food supply.
Using WISEcode AI, an agentic assistant that answers questions in plain language, beta participants can:
Analyze their full portfolio on ingredient quality, nutrient profile, processing level and the health research behind each ingredient
Check the regulatory status of ingredients, including FDA GRAS notices and listings, along with clean-label analysis and dozens of other attributes
Benchmark each product against competitors and find white space in their categories
See what drives each score and which reformulations would move it
Publish products to the WISEcode consumer app and apply for Non-UPF Verification
"Consumers are scrutinizing ingredients more than ever, often with a phone in hand in the grocery aisle," said Craig Anderson, SVP of Industry and Government Solutions at WISEcode. "WISEcode Intelligence lets brands see that judgment before their customers do, against the competitors in their category. It also shows them what to do about it: which ingredient swaps move the score, and where the open space is. The brands that use it first will set the bar everyone else gets measured against."
Feedback from beta participants will shape the full release, expected in early 2027. Food and beverage companies interested in joining the beta can contact [email protected] .
